title: Prescriptions dispensed at the fictional Farmacia Esempio, January to March
bodyMd: The table shows how many prescriptions a fictional neighbourhood pharmacy, Farmacia Esempio, dispensed in each of the first three months of the year, for four therapeutic classes. Each prescription belongs to one class only.

data.caption: Prescriptions dispensed by the fictional Farmacia Esempio in January, February and March, by therapeutic class: antibiotics, antihypertensives, analgesics and antihistamines.

accessibilityText: A table with four data rows and four columns: Therapeutic class, January, February and March. Antibiotics: 120 in January, 90 in February, 60 in March. Antihypertensives: 200, 200 and 200. Analgesics: 100, 110 and 120. Antihistamines: 30, 60 and 120. The monthly totals over the four classes are 450 in January, 460 in February and 500 in March.

provenance.notes: Invented figures for a fictional pharmacy, chosen so that every ratio and percentage in the questions can be worked mentally.
